title: helianthemum canum subsp. incanum
intro: Helianthemum canum subsp. incanum, commonly known as the Incarnate Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the Cistus family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional folk medicine. The health benefits of Helianthemum canum subsp. incanum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which have been shown to exhibit various biological activities.
